title: A flower growing in the sky
explanation: An attractive idea has no basis in reality, like a flower imagined as growing in empty sky. The expression questions feasibility rather than imagination itself.
meaning_odia: ଆକାଶରେ ଫୁଲ ଫୁଟିବା ପରି ଅବାସ୍ତବ କଳ୍ପନା। ଶୁଣିବାକୁ ସୁନ୍ଦର ହେଲେ ବି ଯାହାର ବାସ୍ତବ ଭିତ୍ତି ନାହିଁ, ତାହାକୁ ବୁଝାଏ।
usage_example: A proposal promises a large festival without a venue, funds or anyone to organise it. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: This is a figurative compound, listed as a synonym under ଖପୁଷ୍ପ. The dictionary establishes the image, not a uniquely Odia origin.

witnesses.locator: sense1 synonym and sense2 imaginary/impossible object
